reviewer: principal engineer and game-economy auditor (deep audit, round E)
unresolvedRisks: E-01 (patched in ad23989, not merged): in 58728e8 the Auto-Trainer is switched on when earned and only replays cleared legs; a player who never switches it off is stuck at 3 skills for good (sim: 5/5 seeds, 0 skills from minute 14 to 150)
E-02 (patched in fbbbf87, not merged): clean, super and system prompt XP (and act two slipstream) ignored every XP multiplier; at 10 skills a prompt paid 1/3.5 of what the XP cards promise

The legacy Auto-Trainer card is tagged Automation to stand out, but its levels add no measurable pace: with 11 Insight the sim buys Auto-Trainer level 2 instead of a second Alumni Network level and version 2 reaches General AI 6-44% later on all 5 seeds (median 15.5 -> 19.3 min)

16 of 56 skill-tree nodes (674K of 1.70M tree XP, 40%) only change act one's meter, zone or sprint wait; after General AI (31-38 min) they do nothing for frontier runs, and the dearest (Quantum Network 420K, Wafer-Scale 121K, Round-the-Clock 87.5K XP) only become affordable then. Their effect text doesn't say so

XP stops being the constraint in version 1: passive leg XP is 25-35% of XP to General AI but 85-91% over 150 min; the tree is bought out by 66-84 min and 1M+ XP sits unspent by 100 min; pace is then set by lab income (a full sprint costs 5 s of compute income at skill 8 and 72 s at skill 17) and Scale Up

A ×2 investor XP boost that ends mid-run (or an XP node bought mid-run) mis-records the leg's best run: measured 1.89× permanent passive XP from that leg (the code promises a lucky moment never sets a permanent rate)

For chapter one's end (Superintelligence), when you ship barely matters from 4 to 10 skills (median 60.6-68.9 min total) and later ships finish later (73-87 min); R&D's premise that an early ship 'sets you back' does not hold for that goal

Data (DP), not compute, is what ends runs through chapter one: in 50 ship-then-Superintelligence sims 1,009 of the 1,012 runs that ended because the lab couldn't pay lacked DP (3 lacked CP), and DP-short partial sprints outnumber CP-short ones 1,745 to 801 (2-20× for ships at 6+ skills). A version 1 that never ships hits an income wall past ~70 min: about half its runs (64-89 of 137-166) end unpaid, CP and DP alike

The run loop (sprint luck order, first-summit sizing, settlement, Auto-Trainer policy) lives only in game.js and is hand-copied in tools/sim.js; the sync test checks names and four constants, not behaviour

Performance numbers are from a shared, heavily loaded 4-core VM (load average ~10 from other reviewers): absolute tick/INP/long-task figures are inflated; A/B against 92a207b under the same load shows no regression
Google Fonts is still the only network dependency (a desktop/Steam build must bundle the fonts)
Round D perf harness set AGI.debug.speed, which has no setter: its 5x/20x scenarios ran at 1x (tooling only; round E used setSpeed)
